2608.03844.title: MAFIA: Query-Only Memory Attacks via Probing and Factual Injection against Audited LLM Agents
2608.03844.paper_summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents rely on rich context for long-horizon reasoning and acting, yet their memory modules expose a persistent attack surface for malicious records, making the study of memory poisoning threats imperative. However, existing query-only attacks often fail to remain effective in two realistic and prevalent settings: large-scale benign memory pools and active input auditing. Consequently, current approaches fall short when facing the dual challenges of high retrieval competitiveness and rigorous semantic checks. To overcome these limitations, we propose MAFIA, a query-only Memory Attack framework via probing and Factual Injection against Audit, tailored to this extended threat model. Specifically, MAFIA introduces: (1) a placement strategy that ensures retrieval-competitive injection via memory probing, budget allocation, and scheduling; and (2) a payload design that bypasses audits using compact factual cloaks, preserving malicious effects while maintaining high semantic similarity. Extensive evaluations reveal that MAFIA achieves up to a 90.7% attack success rate while suppressing audit detection from a peak of 83.3% to at most 7.4%, exposing critical vulnerabilities across agentic memory systems. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/JiamingChen1234/MAFIA.
2608.03844.paper_summary_zh: 記憶增強的 LLM 代理依賴於豐富的上下文來進行長期推理和行動，但它們的記憶模組暴露出持續的攻擊面，容易受到惡意記錄的攻擊，因此研究記憶中毒威脅變得至關重要。 然而，現有的僅查詢攻擊在兩個現實且普遍的情境中往往無法保持有效：大規模的良性記憶池和主動輸入審計。 因此，當面對高檢索競爭性和嚴格語義檢查的雙重挑戰時，目前的方法顯得不足。 為了克服這些限制，我們提出了 MAFIA，一個通過探測和事實注入對抗審計的僅查詢記憶攻擊框架，專為這一擴展的威脅模型量身定制。 具體而言，MAFIA 引入了：(1) 一種放置策略，確保通過記憶探測、預算分配和排程進行檢索競爭性注入；以及 (2) 一種有效載荷設計，使用緊湊的事實披風來繞過審計，保留惡意效果的同時保持高語義相似性。 廣泛的評估顯示，MAFIA 在攻擊成功率上達到最高 90.7%，同時將審計檢測從最高的 83.3% 壓制到最多 7.4%，揭示了代理記憶系統中的關鍵漏洞。 代碼將在 https://github.com/JiamingChen1234/MAFIA 上公開。
